dispatchKinds.description: OPTIONAL. Which dispatch kinds the host routes to runners. A host MAY implement `model` first and add `tool` later behind the same capability gate (openwop-app ADR 0182 Phase 5 lands model-dispatch first). Absent ⇒ implementation-defined, but a host SHOULD enumerate what it actually routes.
